description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in to the platform using their Google account via the OAuth flow.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Click on the Google login button.
Verify that the user is redirected to the Google OAuth authentication page.
Enter valid Google account credentials and submit.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the platform dashboard.
Check that the user is logged in and their Google profile data is displayed on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to Google's OAuth page.
User can authenticate using valid Google credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai and logged in successfully.
User's Google profile details are displayed on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Verify behavior when the user cancels login on the Google OAuth page.
Verify behavior when the user provides invalid Google credentials.
Verify behavior when Google's OAuth service is down.
Verify behavior when the redirect URI is tampered with.
Verify behavior when the user's Google account does not have an associated email address.
data_requirements: A valid Google account with email and password.
OAuth client ID and secret configured for the application.
A redirect URI correctly set in the Google OAuth configuration.
Access to the Google OAuth authentication page.
Network connectivity for API calls to Google's servers.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
User's Google account must be active.
The platform must have a configured Google OAuth client ID and secret.
api_interactions: Platform backend API to link Google account data with the user profile.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to Google's OAuth page.
Time taken to authenticate via Google.
Time taken to return to the platform after successful authentication.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that the Google login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Ensure that the Google login button has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify that screen readers can identify and describe the Google login button accurately.
Ensure high contrast visibility of the Google login button.
